hero.headline: I ship fast, accessible **React** and **Next.js** apps — from legacy migrations to greenfield **design systems**.

about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Frontend engineer · Architecture · Performance · Technical writing
paragraphs: I'm a frontend engineer with **six years** of experience shipping **React** and **Next.js** applications across **fintech**, **healthcare**, and consumer products. I'm comfortable owning **architecture** decisions, building **component systems** from scratch, and modernizing **legacy** codebases.

Most recently I lead frontend at **Tapsi Doctor** across **ODoc** (medicine ordering & consultation), **OMS** (order panel), **Physician Panel** (doctor panel), and **VMS** — on a shared **Next.js 15 App Router** stack. I own architecture boundaries, **SSR/SSG** strategy, the **design-system** layer, **Zustand** conventions, **Socket.IO** real-time flows, and **accessibility** — with **~40% faster** initial loads after the App Router migration.
I write actively about **React** internals, **performance** patterns, and the **React 19** compiler. Languages: native Persian; professional English and Turkish; Dutch at A2.
